name: Embed Origins
description: Add third-party embeds by hand: an Embed block for the canvas, plus the operator-approved origins that let the published page's Content-Security-Policy load them.

settings.label: How much a page with an embed may load
settings.description: Compatible: a page that contains an Embed block may load anything over https - scripts, frames, fonts, styles and API calls - so any vendor widget works the moment it is pasted, the way it would on Webflow. Pages with no embed on them are untouched and stay locked down. Strict: a page is allowed only the exact addresses it contains, which is safer and means a widget that calls an API on a different host than it loaded from needs that host adding below.

options.label: Strict - only what the page contains

settings.label: Trust what an editor places on the page (Strict mode only)
settings.description: On: each published page is allowed exactly the iframe and script origins that page turned out to contain, plus a hash of each inline script, so a pasted embed works without anyone editing settings. Per page, never site-wide. Off: nothing is allowed unless it is typed in the boxes below.

settings.label: Allowed iframe origins (frame-src)
settings.description: Additive, and rarely needed while the toggle above is on. One origin per line, scheme included, e.g. https://reputationhub.site. Each is added to frame-src on EVERY published page, whether or not that page contains the embed.

settings.label: Allowed script origins (script-src)
settings.description: Additive, and rarely needed while the toggle above is on. One origin per line. Every origin here can run arbitrary JavaScript on EVERY page of the site, which is broader than the toggle above, so add only origins you trust site-wide.

settings.label: Allowed fetch/XHR origins (connect-src)
settings.description: Additive. One origin per line. Needed only when a widget calls an API on a DIFFERENT host than the script came from — the script's own host is already allowed to be called.

settings.label: Scripts on every page
settings.description: One script URL per line, https only. Each is added to the head of EVERY published page as an async script, and its host may then load scripts, styles, fonts and API calls on every page. For site-wide tools such as the accessibility widget; a widget for one page belongs in an Embed block instead. Takes effect at the next publish.
